language_task: put the bowl on the table
outcome_evidence: The orange bowl begins in the rack (frame 0, left and wrist). The robot approaches and adjusts its grip, then visibly carries the bowl out of the rack toward the tabletop (frames 118–166, left and wrist). At frames 177–183, the bowl is lowered near the tabletop, but the gripper remains at its rim; release and stable, independent support on the table are not clearly established in either left or wrist. Completion is therefore unconfirmed rather than a visibly failed placement. The episode does not establish a separate local failure.
